edges: Brice Robin communicated with CNN regarding the investigation into the crash.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Brice Robin reported that 150 DNA profiles were isolated from over 2,000 DNA samples collected from the crash site.
Both Bild and Paris Match reported claims of a cell phone video showing the crash.
Brice Robin stated that he was not aware of any video footage from on board the plane.
Julian Reichelt claimed to have watched the video and stood by the report.
Julian Reichelt supported the claims made by Paris Match regarding a video of the crash.
